newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends steady but off highs.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends steady but off highs.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended steady but off the day's high as weaker NYMEX heating oil capped gains, traders said.
The December gas oil contract last traded $1.50 up at $220.75 a tonne, 75 cents off it's highs in thin volume trade. December Nymex was off 65 points at 72.75 cents a gallon.

Colder weather forecasts continued to fuel bullish sentiment for gas oil, and this sentiment was reinforced by talk that the trading house with the bulk of the record 865,100 tonne November delivery had indicated it felt it had no need to sell into the market and that it was confident it had homes for the material.
However, physical traders were sceptical. "It all depends on the long, if 200,000-300,000 tonnes comes onto the market premiums, (to the IPE) will collapse," one said
January Brent was stuck in a narrow range and stood nine points lower at $23.51 a barrel.
